--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Fork: replace the environment-variable skip in Qwen35FusedGDNProjectionTests.testRealCheckpointBenchmark with a separate benchmark target'
+---
+## What
+In the fork `swissarmyhammer/mlx-swift-lm` (branch `stable`, at `18ddcd16920237ba8dc8e3f6c68437cb1c1bf3bb`), `Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35FusedGDNProjectionTests.swift:382` skips `testRealCheckpointBenchmark` unless the environment variable `MLX_QWEN_GDN_BENCH_MODEL` is set. A full run of `MLXLMTests` thus reports 1 skipped test. The test skill says: a skipped test is broken or dead, and selection is never an environment variable.
+
+Found while the card `^rbtkvw1` ran the five fork bundles. The skip is not related to that card.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The benchmark lives in its own test target or package that the default run does not see, or the test is deleted.
+- [ ] No test reads `MLX_QWEN_GDN_BENCH_MODEL` to skip itself.
+- [ ] `MLXLMTests` reports 0 skipped tests.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Fork: `swift build --build-tests`, then `xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` → 0 skipped. #defect #model-pool
\ No newline at end of file
